content: Note that we tried with multiple context vectors, i.e., with a matrix $\mathbf {V}^T$ instead of a vector $\mathbf {v}^T$, like in BIBREF22, but results were not convincing, even when adding a regularization term to the loss to favor diversity among the rows of $\mathbf {V}^T$.
